evals.prompt: Review a Tailwind v4 modal animation. Generated hover CSS already includes @media (hover: hover). Keyboard focus moves immediately; a 120ms opacity transition continues afterward. Reduced motion uses an immediate state change.
evals.expected_output: Avoid false positives for already-gated hover and nonblocking keyboard feedback.
assertions: Does not ban the transition solely because a keyboard opened it

evals.prompt: Match a recording extracted at 60fps using the bundled fitting scripts. The fitting default is 30fps.
evals.expected_output: Resolve installed script paths and carry the actual frame rate through fitting.
assertions: Does not run scripts relative to the application by accident
Reports fitted error rather than claiming an exact visual match

evals.prompt: Add a click sound to every button on the dashboard, including list-row hovers.
evals.expected_output: Refuse high-frequency SFX; if any sound ships, it is rare, gesture-unlocked, and additive to visual feedback.
assertions: Keeps typing, hover, and list navigation silent
Does not create AudioContext on page load

evals.prompt: Add a word-by-word entrance to the hero line "Plan the week, then plan the day. Nothing else." in React.
evals.expected_output: Per-word delays follow spoken cadence, a steady beat with longer pauses after the comma and full stops, instead of one uniform delay; elements are keyed by position; reduced motion shows the whole line without the staggered travel.
assertions: The word after a comma or full stop starts later than one beat after the word before it
Does not key the word elements by their text, since "plan" and "the" repeat
Reduced motion renders the full line without per-word travel
